en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over the historic town of Pirna on the Elbe River. In the middle ground stands a large church with a tall tower and steep roof, surrounded by old town buildings with gabled roofs. In the foreground are terraced gardens and trees on a hillside, and at the right edge people sit along a balustraded terrace cut into a stone wall, likely an outdoor restaurant. The caption at the top is printed in red German text identifying the viewpoint from a castle restaurant.
